What you will learn

From electrons to intelligent devices.

Each topic connects a physical effect, a circuit, and the code that controls it.

01

Understand the hardware

GPIO, voltage levels, sensors, buses, memory, wireless connectivity, and the ESP32-S3 architecture.

Explore ESP32 → 02

Write purposeful C code

Variables, decisions, functions, timing, state machines, interrupts, tasks, and robust debugging habits.

See lesson plans → 03

Build and diagnose

Wire real modules, read evidence from the serial monitor, isolate faults, and improve a working prototype.

View projects →

A clear progression

Learn in the order engineers think.

The goal is not simply to copy a sketch. You will learn to predict, measure, explain, and improve what your system is doing.

01

Build

Translate a simple behaviour into a safe circuit and a small, readable program.

02

Observe

Use output, serial data, measurements, and timing to see what the system is actually doing.

03

Debug

Form a hypothesis, change one thing, and use evidence to locate hardware or software faults.

04

Extend

Add a sensor, display, communication link, or control feature without losing reliability.
